description: This file defines the Firefox class, which extends BrowserType, and manages the launching, connection, environment setup, and logging for Firefox browsers within the Playwright core source code.

classes.name: Firefox
classes.description: A class extending BrowserType that implements Firefox-specific logic for launching, connecting, environment setup, and logging within the Playwright core.

methods.name: override launch(progress: Progress, options: types.LaunchOptions, protocolLogger?: types.Proto/ launch
methods.description: Launches a new Firefox browser instance with specified options, delegating to a bidi Firefox if the channel starts with 'moz-'.

methods.name: override async launchPersistentContext(progress: Progress, userDataDir: string, options: chann/ launchPersistentContext
methods.description: Creates a persistent browser context for Firefox, potentially using a bidi Firefox if the channel indicates so.

methods.name: override connectToTransport(transport: ConnectionTransport, options: BrowserOptions): Promise</ connectToTransport
methods.description: Establishes a connection to a Firefox instance over the given transport.

methods.name: override doRewriteStartupLog(logs: string): string { doRewriteStartupLog
methods.description: Processes and rewrites startup logs for better readability, adding ASCII boxes for specific error messages.

methods.name: override amendEnvironment(env: NodeJS.ProcessEnv): NodeJS.ProcessEnv { amendEnvironment
methods.description: Modifies environment variables for launching Firefox, particularly handling home directory paths and SNAP-related variables on Linux.

methods.name: override attemptToGracefullyCloseBrowser(transport: ConnectionTransport): void { attemptToGracefullyCloseBrowser
methods.description: Sends a message to close the browser gracefully via the transport.

methods.name: override async defaultArgs(options: types.LaunchOptions, isPersistent: boolean, userDataDir: s/ defaultArgs
methods.description: Generates default command-line arguments for launching Firefox, including handling headless mode and user data directory.

methods.name: override waitForReadyState(options: types.LaunchOptions, browserLogsCollector: RecentLogsColle/ waitForReadyState
methods.description: Waits for the browser to be ready by listening to specific log messages indicating the Juggler protocol is active.
